title: This Is How You Lose the Time War
author: Amal El-Mohtar
summary: Two agents on opposite sides of a war that stretches across all of time begin leaving each other letters in unlikely places. A short novella told through those messages, it grows from taunting into something much tenderer.
readIf: you like lyrical, inventive love stories and don't mind a plot that is felt more than explained.
skipIf: you want clear worldbuilding rules or a conventional, action-driven time-travel plot.

pairings.reason: Another love story bent around time, though warmer, more earthbound and told across one couple's whole life.
Equally strange and beautifully written, with a short, dreamlike mystery that rewards slow reading.
If you liked the espionage and rival cultures, this gives them a larger political canvas and a longer story.
